about: Rows F1-*, F2-*, F3-* and F4-* for the UAE Information Assurance Standard library (frameworks/uae_ia.json): the four national security policies of its Annex F, one row per numbered policy section (sub-domain), in the shape of the library's own rows. F1 = Table 13 National Encryption Policy, F2 = Table 14 National Secure Remote Work Policy, F3 = Table 15 National Third Party Security Policy, F4 = Table 16 National Data Exchange Security Policy; control_id = the annex prefix, a dash and the sub-domain's printed number. Built from the standard's PDF by backend/grc/tools/build_uae_ia_annex_f_rows.py; text verbatim, evidence_requirements from uae_ia_annex_f_evidence.json. Staging only, to be merged into the library: the seeder does not read this file.
source: UAE Information Assurance Standard, Version 2.1, November 2025 (UAE Cyber Security Council, classification Open)
